notes.TWN: 環境部《2026 年中華民國國家溫室氣體排放清冊報告》：2024 年氧化亞氮排放 339 萬公噸 CO₂ 當量，EDGAR 估計 490 萬公噸，多 44.3%（EDGAR 另外估計了氮沉降的間接排放，廢水的排放也比較多）。
notes.SDN: 含南蘇丹：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.ISR: 含巴勒斯坦：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.SRB: 含蒙特內哥羅與科索沃：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.CHE: 含列支敦斯登：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.FRA: 含摩納哥：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.ESP: 含安道爾：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。
notes.ITA: 含聖馬利諾與梵蒂岡：EDGAR 沒有把它們分開計算，人均用合計的人口。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan's Ministry of Environment, 2026 National Greenhouse Gas Inventory Report: nitrous oxide emissions in 2024 were 3.4 Mt CO₂e; EDGAR estimates 4.9 Mt, 44.3% higher (EDGAR also counts indirect emissions from nitrogen deposition, and more from wastewater).
notesEn.SDN: Includes South Sudan, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.ISR: Includes Palestine, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.SRB: Includes Montenegro and Kosovo, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.CHE: Includes Liechtenstein, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.FRA: Includes Monaco, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.ESP: Includes Andorra, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
notesEn.ITA: Includes San Marino and Vatican City, which EDGAR does not report separately; per-person values use the combined population.
